item.title: Vehicles driving too fast on Barrington Avenue, particularly around the bend by the local park, creating a danger to pedestrians and children., 19th August
item.description:
The main area of concern is the bend on Barrington Avenue directly in front of the local park. Vehicles regularly travel too fast along Barrington Avenue and around this bend. There is no pavement in this area, so pedestrians, including children, have to walk in the road. Children also regularly walk and play around the park, which makes the speed of vehicles particularly concerning. I would like the council to consider adding a SLOW sign/road marking or another appropriate traffic-calming measure to encourage drivers to reduce their speed, particularly when approaching the bend and park.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 18, Barrington Avenue, Hatherley, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
